title: Finite-ring compact-support site comparisons respect refinements and towers
statement:
Let $R$ be a finite commutative ring. Work on ordinary constant-$R$ module derived categories of the small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Let all schemes be Noetherian, meaning they admit finite affine covers by spectra of Noetherian rings. For a compactifiable separated finite-type map $h:U\to V$, choose $c=(j:U\hookrightarrow W,r:W\to V)$ and put $F_h^{t,c}=Rr_*^t j_!^t$ on site $t$ [def-amb-etale-compact-support] [def-asd-compactifiable]. Write $N_T=\nu_T^*$ [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism] and define $C_h^c=Rr_*^{\rm pro}(e_j)\circ d_r(j_!^{\rm et}(-))$, using the canonical open comparison $e_j$ and proper counit mate $d_r$ [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison] [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate]. For $E\in D^+(U_{\rm et},R)$ the map $C_h^c$ is invertible. For a proper refinement $u$ of $c$ by $c'$ let $\rho^t:F_h^{t,c}\to F_h^{t,c'}$ be the normalized proper-refinement comparison, the direct image of the proper/open refinement map $\alpha_u$ of [def-weil-pbc-proper-open-comparison] on the etale site and of its pro-etale counterpart $\alpha_u^{\rm pro}$ of [lem-sp-refinement-coefficient-mate] on etale-origin pro-etale objects. For the composition assertion let $X\xrightarrow fY\xrightarrow gZ$ be composable compactifiable separated finite-type maps of Noetherian schemes, choose compactifications of $f$, $g$ and $gf$, and let $\alpha^t:F_g^tF_f^t\to F_{gf}^t$ be the normalized composition through compatible compactification towers [lem-amb-etale-compact-comparisons] [lem-cbc-compactifiable-compatible-tower]. On etale-origin pro-etale objects use the corresponding proper/open pastes, with the pro-etale interchange $\Gamma^{\rm pro}$ of [lem-sp-proper-open-coefficient-mate]. Then
$$ C_h^{c'}\circ N_V(\rho^{\rm et})=\rho^{\rm pro}N_U\circ C_h^c,$$
$$ C_{gf}N_Z(\alpha^{\rm et})=\alpha^{\rm pro}N_X\circ F_g^{\rm pro}(C_f)\circ C_g(F_f^{\rm et}(-)).$$
Thus the computed pro-etale proper/open comparisons coincide with transport through $C$. These equations hold through every common refinement, and respect identity maps and associativity. They are natural in $E$ and impose no special coefficient presentation or assumption that the base field is algebraically closed. Schemes and Noetherian rings use [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring].
